purpose: Define the skeleton-first carpal rebuild target as 3D centroid/axis/contact geometry, not arbitrary equal Blender-stick lengths.
current_problem: Six of eight carpal reference sticks are exactly 11 mm in a003, showing that the row is a schematic layout rather than anatomically proportioned 3D carpal geometry.
The equal-stick pattern is incompatible with CT evidence showing a consistent size hierarchy: capitate > hamate > scaphoid > trapezium > lunate > trapezoid > triquetrum > pisiform.
Because these Blender bones are functional reference sticks, simply replacing each stick with the published maximum whole-bone length would also be wrong.

required_per_carpal: principal/geometric axis orientation in the neutral wrist
bone-specific reference dimensions stored separately from rig-stick length
explicit parent/follower mechanics only after contact/kinematic evidence is mapped
canonical_representation.frame_policy: Map published carpal axes into the HGPT radial/wrist frame explicitly; never copy signed angles until coordinate handedness and axis definitions are reconciled.
canonical_representation.size_policy: Use 3D maximum-length/volume ordering as a plausibility constraint on anatomical geometry, not as a mandatory control-bone length.

acceptance_tests: No arbitrary equal-length template may remain unless an evidence-backed measurement definition justifies it.
All eight carpal centres must be distinct and ordered consistently with the hand/wrist anatomy.
Neutral axes must fall within mapped source corridors or carry a documented reason for deviation.
Published source-frame signs must be transformed into the HGPT frame and unit-tested for world-space anatomical direction.
Wrist motion tests must distinguish radiocarpal from midcarpal contribution; carpal geometry may not be accepted solely because the hand tip follows the commanded wrist angle.
Mesh shape must later be fit around the canonical carpal/metacarpal skeleton; current r95 wrist/palm width is not a freeze criterion.

resolved: neutral line-axis targets for scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate and hamate mapped into HGPT world basis
adult-male bone-specific 3D bounding-box envelope constraints for all eight carpals
still_blocked: absolute 3D centroid positions for all eight bones in one canonical radial frame
explicit source-X/Y/Z to HGPT envelope-axis mapping
